_help: Edit these to match your account. risk_per_trade_usd = the most you are willing to lose if the stop is hit.

swing._help: Shadow test only (shown as 🧪 in alerts, compared in the EOD summary). Stop = low of the last 2 five-minute candles. Sell partials at 3R and 5R, the rest on the first daily close below EMA9. account_usd + risk_pct size the trade (null = use risk_per_trade_usd). variants: each alert is tested once per variant; 'id' is stored in history/swing_trades.csv, 'name' is only the letter shown (be3r = stop to entry after the 3R sale; be3r_d1 = also sell everything at the signal day's close unless 3R was reached).

variants.name: B
variants.label: A + out at day-1 close unless 3R
